text:
sam: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp failing when running embed + rerank under throttled network. Error points to vector dim mismatch and dup responses.

ivy: can you paste the error and the outgoing request?

sam: server error: 
```
{"error":"bad_request","message":"vector dim mismatch: expected=1536 got=1531 (item 2)"}
```
outgoing (captured):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "vectors": [ [0.12,0.34,... /* some trailing zeros missing */], [0.98,0.01,...] ],
  "query": "onboarding steps"
}
```

frank: two separate things colliding: 1) sampleapp emits top-level `vectors` instead of `items: [{id,vector}]` so runtime can't attach ids consistently for retries; 2) our JS/browser serializer is compacting arrays (trimming trailing zeros) to reduce payload size which changes lengths. Batcher's index->id mapping then shifts and retries create duplicates.

ivy: repro steps: clone sampleapp -> yarn && yarn start -> run onboard flow under throttling (chrome network slow 3G) -> observe 400s and duplicate responses occasionally. I can repro ~1/8 runs.

sam: minimal local mitigation I pushed: middleware that (a) maps `vectors` -> `items` with stable ids, (b) pads shorter vectors to modelDim (1536) before send. snippet: 
```
function normalize(body,dim=1536){
  const items = (body.vectors||[]).map((v,i)=>({id:`s-${i}`, vector: padTo(v,dim)}));
  return { items, query: body.query }
}
```

frank: SDK action items: stop trimming trailing zeros by default; add `preserveTrailingZeros` boolean and `padVectors` option; add parity unit tests across Node/Python/Android/iOS. Also add pre-send validator in batch helper that fails fast with a clear message if dims vary.

ivy: runtime UX ask: can we make vector-dim errors more actionable? e.g., "expected=1536 got=1531 (item=2). Hint: client may trim trailing zeros or send top-level vectors vs items. See internal guide: https://go.internal/vector-dims" and add header `X-Redwood-Vector-Debug: expected=1536;got=1531` to help clients triage.

sdk-qa-bot: filed issues: sampleapp#1203 (middleware stopgap), sdk#512 (preserveTrailingZeros + padVectors + parity tests), runtime#RN-471 (better error + debug header). Assignments: @frank SDK, @ivy sampleapp.

frank: I'll draft the JS patch to stop compacting arrays and add the pad option. Will include unit tests that assert JSON.stringify does not drop zeros when option enabled. Also adding idempotency keys per item in the batch helper to avoid duplicates on retries.

ivy: QA will run Canary with the sampleapp middleware until SDK patch merges. We'll then remove middleware and rerun e2e across node/browser/mobile emulators.

sam: thanks. Posting repro captures & Charles HAR in the SDK issue for easier debugging. Leaving this thread open until SDK PR merges. :white_check_mark:
